interpretation: The paper's industrial chassis strain L10 (and its derivatives L320/L321) are not indexed in BV-BRC under that strain label. Five other S. chattanoogensis isolates are available (8.3-9.1 Mb; consistent with the species' large genome that the paper deletes 0.7-1.3 Mb from). The L10 genome was historically released under NCBI BioProject PRJNA208758 / NZ_AGSW00000000 by Liu et al. 2013; the paper relies on that prior reference and provides no new sequencing deposit for L320/L321 in BV-BRC.
